self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Jade Circulation: when not on the field for more than 5s, Max HP +64% and Elemental Mastery +80 (canceled after 10s on-field).

en.flavor: An ancient jade pendant that gleams like clear water. It seems to have been used in ancient ceremonies.

refinements.1: When not on the field for more than 5s, Max HP will be increased by <r>32%</r> and Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>40</r>. These effects will be canceled after the wielder has been on the field for 10s.
refinements.2: When not on the field for more than 5s, Max HP will be increased by <r>40%</r> and Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>50</r>. These effects will be canceled after the wielder has been on the field for 10s.
refinements.3: When not on the field for more than 5s, Max HP will be increased by <r>48%</r> and Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>60</r>. These effects will be canceled after the wielder has been on the field for 10s.
refinements.4: When not on the field for more than 5s, Max HP will be increased by <r>56%</r> and Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>70</r>. These effects will be canceled after the wielder has been on the field for 10s.
refinements.5: When not on the field for more than 5s, Max HP will be increased by <r>64%</r> and Elemental Mastery will be increased by <r>80</r>. These effects will be canceled after the wielder has been on the field for 10s.

fr.flavor: Un ancien pendentif en jade qui brille comme de l'eau claire. Il semble avoir été utilisé dans des cérémonies anciennes.

refinements.1: Après avoir fait partie de l'équipe sans être déployé pendant plus de 5 s, les PV max augmentent de <r>32 %</r> et la maîtrise élémentaire de <r>40</r> pts. L'effet prend fin dès que le personnage équipé de l'arme est déployé et passe 10 s sur le terrain.
